literal: 'I come from this country: {}'; de contracts with a country's own gender/number (du Japon, des Pays-Bas, d'Italie), which would need most names inflected, so the case is fixed on 'pays' and the name follows as a label
provenance: fr-agent-v1;rewritten-for-fill-in=de + country needs du/des/d' for most names depending on gender and number (Bescherelle: pays masculins/feminins/pluriels apres de), so the preposition is fixed on 'ce pays' and the bare name is given as an appositive after the colon;ipa=espeak
